lines.english: “Damn...!”

lines.japanese: なんという不覚のきわみ。これまで肉体的窮地に直面する機会なんてほとんどなかった俺の視床下部は、突然の不測の事態において、あろうことか自らの生命に対する防衛本能を最優先で働かせていた。
lines.english: What a shameful failure. My hypothalamus, almost entirely untested by physical danger, had met this sudden crisis by doing the unthinkable: placing the preservation of my own life above all else.

lines.japanese: つまり、その一瞬、俺の体は動かなかった。
lines.english: In other words, for that one instant, my body did not move.

lines.japanese: 悲鳴すら出せないまま身を縮める日和子さん。そのかすか頭上をウッドチェアーの残骸が凶悪な速度でかすめ過ぎていった。
lines.english: Hiyoko shrank into herself, unable even to scream. The wreckage of the wooden chair hurtled past a hair above her head at murderous speed.

lines.japanese: 取りまいていた通行人が騒然と叫ぶ。空を裂いた砲弾は、夕刻の路上に落ちて砕けちった。
lines.english: The surrounding pedestrians erupted in alarm. The projectile that had torn through the air struck the evening street and shattered.

lines.japanese: <8>\「今度こそァァァ！」
lines.english: “This time...!”

lines.japanese: 狂乱した男は逃げることさえ忘れたのか、その場ですぐさま次弾を放った。
lines.english: Perhaps the frenzied man had forgotten even to flee. Without moving from the spot, he immediately launched his next round.

lines.japanese: 「日和子さん！」
lines.english: “Hiyoko!”

lines.japanese: 筋肉の委縮は解けていた。今度こそ俺は、両脚の瞬発力を爆発させてコンクリートを蹴った。
lines.english: My muscles were no longer frozen. This time, I drove off the concrete with every ounce of power in my legs.

lines.japanese: 「危ないっ！」
lines.english: “Look out!”

lines.japanese: そして飛びつくや否や、日和子さんの肩と頭をしゃにむに鷲づかみ、力まかせに胸の中へ引きよせる。
lines.english: The instant I reached her, I seized Hiyoko by the head and shoulders and wrenched her against my chest with all my strength.
“Gaugh!”

lines.japanese: 瞬間、痛みだか衝撃だか何だかが耳とこめかみを打ちつけ、視界に白光が弾けた。殴られてもいない首の後ろに、ずきりと鋭い痛みが走る。内側から忍びよる重い感覚。どこかで誰かが俺を嗤っていた。
lines.english: In that instant, something—pain, impact, I could no longer tell—slammed into my ear and temple, and white light burst across my vision. A sharp pain lanced through the back of my neck, though nothing had struck it. A leaden sensation crept toward me from within. Somewhere, someone was laughing at me.

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん！　千歳さん！」
lines.english: “Chitose! Chitose!”

lines.japanese: これは──違う、聴覚に直接飛びこんでくる叫び声。これは、ああ、なんだ、日和子さんだ。
lines.english: No—this was different. A cry pouring straight into my ears. This was... Oh. Of course. Hiyoko.

lines.japanese: 「ひよこさん……いいから、にげて……」
lines.english: “Hiyoko... Never mind me. Run...”

lines.japanese: 俺の、意識は、薄れてゆく。
lines.english: My... consciousness... was fading.

lines.japanese: 「て、店長大変です！　千歳さんが！」
lines.english: “M-Manager, something terrible has happened! Chitose—!”

lines.japanese: ああ、良かった、マスターが来てくれたならもう大丈夫だ……なにしろ彼はああ見えて空手の有段者……内緒だけど、若いころは一端のケンカ番長だとか……。
lines.english: Ah, good. The boss was here. Everything would be all right now... Despite appearances, he had a black belt in karate... and though it was a secret, rumor said he'd been a notorious brawler in his youth...

lines.japanese: 「よかった……ひよこさん……」
lines.english: “Thank goodness... Hiyoko...”

lines.japanese: い、いやあ、餅は餅屋ってね……慣れないことはするもんじゃありません。
lines.english: W-well, best leave it to the professionals, as they say... A man shouldn't try his hand at things he doesn't know.

lines.japanese: あはは、かっこわる……。
lines.english: Ahaha. How pathetic...

lines.japanese: そして俺の意識は、あるべきところからずるりと引きずりおとされました。
lines.english: And then my consciousness slipped from its proper place and was dragged down.
